Freedom of Information Act Request re: Dun Nor Estate, Donaskeigh, Co.Tipperary • A copy of the taking in charge application submitted to Tipperary County Council by residents of Dun Nor in May 2013 and any supplementary documents submitted with this application. • Any record pertaining to a determination of the taking in charge application submitted in 2013 to Tipperary County Council and any internal or external correspondence with residents of Dun Nor or their local representatives raising concerns on their behalf regarding the consideration and/or determination of same. • A copy of Tipperary County Council's current taking in charge policy and any taking in charge policy that preceded any current policy from 2013 to present. • Records, reports and correspondence pertaining to any inspections or assessments by Tipperary County Council staff, or any agents of or professionals engaged by Tipperary County Council, carried out on the Dun Nor estate and its water treatment plant between 2010 and present day. • Records, reports and correspondence pertaining to any de-sludging work undertaken by or on behalf of Tipperary County Council on Dun Nor's water treatment plant since 2010. • A copy of any reports relating to assessments carried out by Tipperary County Council staff or external
